guestDescription: Analyze a public GitHub PR, read the report and review findings without an account. Save your result link to return before it expires.
guestAnalyzeDescription: Paste a Pull Request from a public repository. Preview it, then confirm to start analysis.

guestAccessRequired: Enter the guest token or open your saved result link.
guestAccountDescription: Sign in for personal history, analysis preferences and version comparison. Existing guest reviews remain accessible through their original result links.
tagline: Understand every change. Focus on real risks.
deskImageAlt: A sunlit code review desk with a laptop, printed code and an orange pencil.
deskCaption: Tools find the clues. You make the call.
homeDescription: Drop in a Pull Request. See what changed and what deserves a closer look. Read code with context, and make your own call.
privacy: Analysis sends code changes and necessary context to the configured model service. Confirm you are authorized to submit this code.
analysisUnavailable: Analysis is not available yet. Preview, creation, cancellation and retry are unavailable. You can continue reviewing existing tasks.
comparisonUnavailable: Version comparison is not available yet. Version selection and result views are ready for integration.
deletionUnavailable: Task deletion is not available yet.
reusable: An analysis already exists for this commit
invalidPr: Enter a valid HTTPS GitHub Pull Request URL.
invalidTask: Enter a valid positive integer task ID.
feature1Text: Start with the intent, affected modules and files that deserve your time.
feature2Text: Go back to the Diff. Check the context. Decide whether it is a real issue.
feature3Text: Accept it, revise it or mark a false positive. Keep your reasoning in the report.
logoutConfirm: Are you sure you want to sign out?

usernameCharacters: Use English letters, digits and underscores only.

loginHint: Access guest reviews using the result link containing the guest token.

invalidResponse: The service returned an unrecognized response.

author: Author
